## About
Ronnie's Electronics started out working out of the basement of a swap meet. Today drivers from Chula Vista to Oceanside make the trip to our National City shop and showroom for car audio, custom wheels, tires and accessories for cars, trucks and boats.
This is a family business. Customers know Ronnie, Adam and Eli by name, and one longtime customer even thanked Ronnie's mother for her kindness. One reviewer calls us "a pillar of low riding community in SD," and you can look for us at DUB, Extreme Auto Fest and Lowrider car shows.
We start every job by talking through your options, then do the install right here in our own shop. Neighbors rate us 4.7 from 125 Google reviews.

## Services
- Car Stereo: Head unit upgrades, new speakers and full stereo systems, installed by our car stereo installers.
- Car Alarms: Car alarm installation for cars and trucks.
- Marine Audio: New marine audio systems and boat speakers.
- Custom wheels, tires and suspension: Rims, tires and suspension work, plus the auto accessories to go with them.
- Remote car starters and navigation systems: Tell us the remote starter or navigation system you have in mind and we'll talk you through what would work best.
- Mobile video installs: Video installs for your car or truck.

## FAQ
Q: Can I get an estimate before I commit?
A: Yes. Call us for a free estimate on your car customization.

Q: Do you work with drivers outside National City?
A: Yes. We're based in National City and help drivers throughout the greater San Diego region, including Chula Vista, Lemon Grove, La Mesa, El Cajon, Alpine, Oceanside, Escondido, Santee and La Jolla.

Q: What happens when I come in?
A: We start by talking through your options for car, truck or other accessories. Once we know what you want, we do the installation and hand back a vehicle customized to your specifications.
